descriptors.note: the measured_ columns are human measurements, carried through and never fitted against

endpoint.definition: p_activity(primary target) - p_toxicity(hERG, CHEMBL240), both -log10 mol/L
endpoint.direction: higher is a wider margin over the cardiac liability
endpoint.is_not: not LD50/ED50, not a clinical therapeutic index, not dose-aware, not safety evidence
endpoint.name: therapeutic_index

ranking_rule: ranked within each target, never across them: rank_in_target 1 is the widest margin among the molecules routed to that same local model

routing.basis: Morgan r=2 top-5 mean Tanimoto against each local model's training set
routing.is_not: a measured target assignment; a routed target is an inference from structure

routing_rule: activity only from a model fitted on the molecule's own target; no pooling across targets. The target comes from ChEMBL's mechanism table where one is recorded, otherwise from ti/router.py on structure alone, and target_source says which.

source_exclusions.reason: table exported without its header row; the cells hold several molecules' values run together and cannot be split without guessing which value belongs to which molecule

the target schema's measurement columns are blank in the source (9060 non-empty cells across all rows and columns, mostly identity and ATC); no Activity, Toxicity or Therapeutic Index value can be read from it
